author: SGreenwell
what_it_is: Characters at the end of the game. Many have maxed out stats. Gremio alive, best ending possible. Works with Suikoden 2.
format: DexDrive .gme cut short: '123-456-STD' 3904-byte header + only the first 24576 bytes of the card (3 of 16 blocks); the card holds 1 save(s), 1 for this game (BASLUS-00292GENSOU02)

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/psx-card.py card.mcr suikoden.1062.gme: unwraps the card (DexDrive .gme: 3904-byte header + card (only 24576 card bytes, zero-padded to 131072))

beetle-psx.detail: Continue game lists the file: Steve, Lv. 64 (no card: "No data on Memory card")

beetle-psx-hw.detail: Continue game lists the file: Steve, Lv. 64 (no card: "No data on Memory card") (the same screen as on beetle-psx)

pcsx-rearmed.detail: Continue game lists the file: Steve, Lv. 64 (no card: "No data on Memory card") (the same screen as on beetle-psx)

swanstation.detail: Continue game lists the file: Steve, Lv. 64 (no card: "No data on Memory card") (the same screen as on beetle-psx)

duckstation.detail: not runnable here: no macOS build of the DuckStation libretro core

psx-mister.detail: not runnable here: a MiSTer FPGA core

note: The converter pads the missing blocks with zeroes, as DuckStation's ImportCardGME does; the saves on the card all lie in the blocks present. one-saves (1saves convert) does not read this file: a PS1 memory card is 131072 bytes, or that behind a DexDrive, VGS or PSP header, but this file is 28480 bytes
